backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing a real estate platform with user profiles, partner registration, property listings with approval workflow, lead management, commission tracking, and QubeYards currency rewards system using persistent storage and access control.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that converts old property and commission data structures to new schema with enhanced transaction types, project stages, property status enums, and commission status enums.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including pan-India location support, offers display, project stage categorization, property approval workflow, and news section with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing components, pages, hooks, and styling for the QubeYards luxury real estate platform with teal/gold branding.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables for QubeYards premium branding including teal, gold, and neutral color palettes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with QubeYards title, meta description for premium real estate platform, and root div for React application mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for login, dashboard, leads, commissions, news, and admin properties, wrapped in theme provider with authentication guards and profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/AddLeadForm.tsx: Form component for adding new leads with customer name input, validation, submission handling using useAddLead mutation hook, and success/error toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AuthGuard.tsx: Protects routes by checking Internet Identity authentication status, redirecting unauthenticated users to home and showing a loading spinner during initialization.
frontend/src/components/CommissionSummar: Displays three summary cards showing total earned commissions, pending commissions, and payment count with icons and formatted currency values.
Renders a table of commission records with ID, amount, status badges, and payment dates, including loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/CurrencyBalanceC: Displays the user's QubeYards currency balance in a gradient card with a custom currency icon and descriptive text.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header navigation, conditional menu items based on auth/admin status, and footer with branding.
frontend/src/components/LeadCard.tsx: Displays a single lead in a card format with customer name, user icon, and color-coded status badge.
frontend/src/components/LeadList.tsx: Shows a grid of lead cards with add new lead button and toggleable form, including loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states, clearing query cache on logout, and error handling for authentication issues.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to complete their channel partner profile with name, company, contact, and license information.
frontend/src/components/PropertyCard.tsx: Displays a single property card with image, location, price, status badges, and an optional approve button for admins. Handles property approval mutation and formats display values for property type, status, project stage, and transaction type.
frontend/src/components/PropertyList.tsx: Renders a filterable grid of property cards with search by location and filters for type, status, project stage, and transaction type. Shows loading skeletons while data is fetching.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Initializes access control with admin token from URL params and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow and identity state. Creates AuthClient with configurable options and handles identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend API calls including user profiles, properties, leads, commissions, and admin operations. Each hook uses the actor from useActor and manages query/mutation state with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for a premium teal and gold color palette in both light and dark modes. Sets up design tokens for backgrounds, borders, accents, and sidebar components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component. Wraps the app with necessary context providers for state management and authentication.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPropertiesPage.t: Admin page for reviewing and approving pending property listings. Checks admin permissions and displays properties with 'pendingApproval' status using PropertyCard components with approve buttons.
frontend/src/pages/CommissionsPage.tsx: Displays commission tracking dashboard with summary cards and a table showing earnings and payment history. Fetches commission data using useGetCommissions hook.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page with hero banner, property statistics, QubeYards balance card for partners, special offers banner, and property listings. Shows available, residential, and commercial property counts.
frontend/src/pages/LeadsPage.tsx: Lead management page displaying total, new, in-progress, and closed leads with statistics cards. Uses LeadList component to show and manage customer leads by status.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page with Internet Identity authentication, QubeYards branding, and feature highlights (pan-India properties, rewards, partner network). Redirects authenticated users to dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/NewsPage.tsx: News and magazine page displaying real estate articles in a grid layout with hero section. Shows 6 hardcoded articles covering market trends, investment guides, legal info, and sustainability topics.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing. Includes sessionStorage persistence helpers and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color palette using OKLCH color space, extended theme with sidebar/chart colors, custom shadows, Inter font family, and accordion animations. Includes typography, container queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file for QubeYards real estate platform defining existing features including partner registration, property listings, lead management, commission tracking, Internet Identity authentication, and admin-controlled approvals with currency rewards system. Contains architectural notes, image requirements, and feature tracking with requirement IDs.
